snippet.title: My Beautiful Vacation
snippet.description:
My Beautiful Vacation for PC: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/8092/my-beautiful-vacation/index.html

My Beautiful Vacation for Mac: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/7807/mac/my-beautiful-vacation/index.html

Play the role of Jack, the fun-loving teenager, and experience a Colorful Carnival! Travel with him to witness a new world full of wonder in My Beautiful Vacation. The journey includes adventures in a birds sanctuary, an amusement park, a studio, a magic tent, an aquarium and many other fun locations! Use your Hidden Object talents to help Jack, known for his enthusiasm and bravery, relive some of his favorite memories.

  * Multiple minigames
  * Perplexing puzzles and riddles
  * Enjoy a Beautiful Vacation!
